DocuSign Envelope ID: 529F7313-1CD9-4D51-8E11-1836D0CD81CB L-4565 MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BY AND BETWEEN METROPOLITAN PUBLIC HEALTH DEPARTMENT AND NASHVILLE FIRE DEPARTMENT EMS This Memorandum of Understanding (hereinafter "MOU") is made and entered into by and between the Metropolitan Public Health Department (hereinafter “MPHD") and Nashville Fire Department (hereinafter "NFD-EMS"), both of which, for the purposes of this agreement, are agencies or departments of the Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County, a governmental, municipal and public corporation created and existing under and by virtue of the Constitution and Laws of the State of Tennessee. MPHD and NFD-EMS are entering into this MOU pursuant to the grant that was approved by the Metropolitan Council under RS2020-373. Scope of Services: This scope of services reflects an agreement between the MPHD and NFD-EMS to provide contractual substance misuse epidemic response services to the Substance Abuse Reduction program utilizing a Fire Captain. The tasks below list some of the primary responsibilities of this memorandum of understanding.
1. THE PARTIES HEREBY AGREE TO THE FOLLOWING TERMS AND CONDITIONS: MPHD commits to: A. Coordinate overdose reduction activities with identified points of contact with NFD-EMS as part of a wider overdose response effort B. Share and analyze relevant information with NFD-EMS EMS commits to: A. Identify individuals with a confirmed overdose status in NFD-EMS data B. Work with the Mental Health Cooperative (MHC) and MPHD to carry out a post- overdose follow up communication (either by phone or in person) C. Make a referral to Substance Use Disorder (SUD) treatment services or provide educational/support material/resources to identified individuals or their family/friends/ Mutual responsibilities: A. The MOU will be jointly reviewed annually or more frequently if laws and regulations are amended that will significantly impact this agreement, or whenever a party requests a formal change.
2. CONTRACT TERM: The term of this MOU will begin on December 1, 2019 until August 31, 2021.
3. COMPENSATION: EMS will invoice MPHD monthly in a manner to be agreed upon in the future. Compensation provided by MPHD shall not exceed sixty-four thousand seven hundred ninety-four dollars ($64,792) for the year one of the contract, December 1, 2019 through August 31, 2020. Compensation for year two of the contract, September 1, 2020 through August 31, 2021 shall not exceed eighty-two thousand one hundred eighty-nine dollars ($82,189). (02220633)
DocuSign Envelope ID: 529F7313-1CD9-4D51-8E11-1836D0CD81CB
4. AMENDMENTS: This MOU may be amended at any time by mutual written agreement of the parties.
5. TERMINATION: Any party to this MOU may terminate this agreement by providing the other party written notice of their intent to do so thirty (30) days prior to the date of termination.
6. CONFIDENTIALITY OF RECORDS: All parties acknowledge confidentiality requirements that each party must follow the sharing and release of personally identifiable. It is the intent of the agreement to ensure that parents have rights of access and rights of privacy with respect to such reports and records and that applicable State and Federal laws for exercise of these rights be strictly followed as indicated by the Health Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
